source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
While attacks from **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** weapons resolve, the active player may, as Allocation Order (05.03) starts, pick an allocation group holding a **CHARACTER** model that at least 1 attacking model can see.

That group stays the current allocation group until those attacks finish or it is **destroyed**, whichever comes first.

**Mortal wounds** from a **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** attack with **[[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/devastating-wounds)** go first to that group while it survives.
